learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply the chemical formula language.
They can perform stoichiometric calculations and define different types of bonds.
Students can infer typical properties from the structure of matter.
They are able to calculate chemical equilibria, especially acid-base equilibria, and set up redox equations.
They can describe the processes in galvanic cells and electrolysis and discuss the electrochemical processes of corrosion.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts and definitions in chemistry
Structure of atoms and the electron shell
Systematics in the Periodic Table of Elements
Setting up chemical reaction equations and stoichiometric calculations
Chemical bonds, especially covalent, ionic, and metallic bonds (energy band model)
Galvanic cells and electrolysis, Chemical processes of corrosion
assessment_rules: The module exam must be passed. Grading is weighted by ECTS credits.
bibliography: All documents (script, laboratory documents, etc.) are provided digitally via the e-learning platform. Secondary literature is available as an e-book.
